findings.title: Q3 gate-evidence citability remains internally contradictory
evidence: RESULTS_INDEX.md:38-44 asserts STATUS: CITABLE and restores Q3 as admissible Q0 condition-3 gate evidence; the same current Q3 block at :59-60 says the row stays NOT CITABLE, and :70-73 repeats Status stays NOT CITABLE. Neither later assertion is labelled HISTORICAL, SUPERSEDED, or RETRACTED.

results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_NEB_GATE.md:6-12 records condition 3 as PASS, while results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q3_CLOSURE_RECORD.md:18-20 says Q3 is restored as CITABLE. The current index therefore asserts both citable and non-citable states for the same gate evidence.
reproduce: rg -n 'STATUS: CITABLE|row stays NOT CITABLE|Status stays NOT CITABLE|condition-3 PASS' RESULTS_INDEX.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q3_CLOSURE_RECORD.md

proposed_check: C-STATE-004 amendment — parse every status predicate in the bounded canonical Q3 block, classify only explicitly marked historical/superseded/retracted predicates as non-current, and fail if any current NOT-CITABLE predicate coexists with current STATUS: CITABLE or condition-3 PASS; a fixture retaining this commit's lines 38-44 and 59-60 must fail.

findings.title: Q3 one-state regression masks the current contradictory state
evidence: scripts/20_test_checks.py:1188-1195 defines _q3_banned as a NOT-CITABLE match AND not _q3_citable. Consequently the present bounded Q3 block, which has both predicates, yields citable=True, not_citable=True, current_test_banned=False and does not fail the advertised one-state assertion.

The isolated-copy execution of python3 scripts/20_test_checks.py exited 0 and printed ALL TESTS PASSED despite the unmarked mixed Q3 status documented in F-019; its group [43] output calls the condition OK rather than detecting the contradiction.

proposed_check: C-GUARD-003 — execute the Q3 status regression against a committed fixture that contains both current STATUS: CITABLE and current NOT CITABLE predicates plus a condition-3 PASS row; require nonzero exit, while a fixture where the NOT-CITABLE text is explicitly HISTORICAL passes.
